payload.consequence: The recommendation was reversed one turn later when the user asked for a determination; the ADR was then written, accepted, and added to the ADR index. A user-visible reversal of a stated recommendation. No wrong artifact was published, because the same recap had offered the ADR as an optional next step.
payload.expected: When the grilling loop ratified a narrowed version of the chosen candidate, the skill side-effect list would indicate whether the narrowing rationale warranted an ADR, since the stated purpose of that offer is to stop future architecture reviews re-suggesting the same thing.
payload.observed: The ADR side effect fires only on the user rejecting a candidate with a load-bearing reason. The user instead accepted a deliberately narrowed candidate, so the trigger did not fire, and the closing recap recommended against an ADR and homed the rationale in the implementation issue.
payload.run_condition: One top-level session. The skill governed the first phase over 4694 source lines, producing six candidates and one HTML report before handing to the grilling loop. The gap surfaced late, at the closing recap after four ratified forks, and was caught by a user follow-up question rather than by any step in the skill.
